coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and .gitignore due to HTTP 400 API errors.
learnings: When a model fails due to transient API errors, the orchestration layer should either retry the request or rely on other models' successful audits rather than forcing an inconclusive verdict if the critical files are covered by another model.
